title_sq: Ne Astir, Tek Alba Konstruksion Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Post Parkimi!!
description_sq: Ne Astir, Tek Alba Konstruksion Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Post Parkimi!! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 82.22m2, neto 72.67, ndodhet ne katin e 2 te nje kompleksi, objekt banimi 7-10 kate me 2 kate parkim nentoke dhe organizohet ne sallonin e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, dy dhomat e gjumit dhe dy tualete .Kompleksi dallohet per punimet teper cilesore duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike-elektrike, termoizolimi i fasades, shtrimi me pllake ose parket sipas deshires se klientit, dritaret dopioxham termike , hapesira pushimi dhe hapesira te gjelberta perreth kompleksit te cilat do te kryhen nga Shoqeria "Alba Konstruksion" shpk. title_en: In Astir, at Alba Konstruktion, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with parking!!
description_en: In Astir, at Alba Konstruktion, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with parking!! The apartment with a total area of 82.22m2, net 72.67, is located on the 2nd floor of a complex, a residential building of 7-10 floors with 2 floors of underground parking and is organized in the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, two bedrooms and two toilets. The complex stands out for its high-quality works, starting from the hydraulic-electrical installations, thermal insulation. of the facade, paving with tiles or parquet according to the customer's wishes, thermal double-glazed windows, rest areas and green spaces around the complex which will be carried out by the Company "Alba Konstruksion" shpk. The apartment has a South-West orientation, which allows natural lighting throughout the day. Along with the apartment, included in the price is a parking space on the 2nd floor.
